comparability.reason: upstream QA scoring uses a separate model-dependent answer evaluator; this profile measures retrieval/currentness only
comparability.retriever_note: no_memory and lexical_overlap are profile-local baselines; upstream flat-bm25/dense retrievers are not reproduced here

letta_archival_local.boundary: Letta server REST archival memory (create_passage / search_archival_memory), local embeddings, no LLM; retrieval only

configuration.database: PostgreSQL 18.1 + pgvector 0.8.5, Letta init.sql + alembic upgrade head
configuration.embedding: OpenAI-compatible loopback endpoint serving fastembed BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (ONNX, 384-d)
configuration.identity_mapping: passage id returned by create_passage -> doc id; ids never in text
configuration.isolation: fresh agent (own archive) per question, deleted afterwards
configuration.llm: none invoked (agent llm_config points at a closed loopback port)
configuration.oversize_items: Letta refuses passages above archival_memory_token_limit; counted, not split

input_loading.method: streaming: incremental UTF-8 + json.JSONDecoder.raw_decode per top-level element (#568)

resource_consumption.method: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss; the process high-water mark, not attributable to one backend

input.duplicate_session_id_note: upstream indexes each repeated haystack session as its own corpus item under the same id; this profile does the same (repeats must carry identical content)
input.sha256_scope: raw source bytes, every byte read in each streaming pass; all passes must agree

agent_memory.boundary: public AgentMemory facade: governed commit; candidate generation followed by canonical governed admission

latest_gold_ranked_first.definition: among scored knowledge-update questions with gold items on >=2 distinct dates, fraction where the most recently dated gold item is returned ahead of every older gold item
